# Stripe OpenAPI external source dossier

This dossier was generated from immutable public Stripe OpenAPI tags without invoking the DCG JAR.

- manifest: `stripe-openapi-external-manifest-v3.json`
- transitions: 46 audited single-mutation candidates
- source copies: `sources/` (four original `openapi/spec3.json` files)
- source audit: `../../../docs/stripe-openapi-source-audit.md`
- traceability disposition and full rejection-skew audit: `stripe-traceability-only-audit.json`
- post-disposition V9 overlap preflight: `v9-preflight-report-after-traceability.json`
- no SAFE/WARNING/BREAKING labels are present

The 16 records that pass V9 overlap checks are retained for provenance and
traceability only. They are not model-accuracy evidence: the selected Stripe
sample has sparse breaking-change coverage, and its rejected records overlap
V9 structurally in feature space rather than by raw source-pair identity.
